title: Canon at the fifth: one wrong note
intro: A two-voice canon: the second voice enters one bar later, a fifth higher. One note is wrong. Find it and fix it.
source: Written for Canon Workbench as a practice piece.
hints: Remember that every note you change also changes the second voice, a fifth higher, one bar later.
The errors are in bars 3 and 4: a wrong note clashes once when the leader sings it, and again a bar later when the follower sings it a fifth higher.
The leader's third bar starts on the wrong note.
